label: Acros#0
description:
# Acros — Classic Black-and-White Photography

This collection of recipes captures the spirit of classic black-and-white film — deep blacks, luminous highlights, expressive grain, and just the right amount of contrast. Lifted shadows, high Clarity, and expanded Dynamic Range give each shot a dimensional, refined quality, ranging from infrared-style cross processing to the subtlety of split toning. Perfect for portraits, architecture, and documentary work where you need maximum expressiveness of form and texture, without the distraction of color.

label: Acros#1
description:
# Acros Preset Group Description

A set of monochrome recipes united by the dark, contrasty aesthetic of black-and-white film with pronounced grain. These presets are a natural fit for portraiture, documentary, and street photography — anywhere you need rich blacks and smooth midtone gradation. Reduced Clarity and a gentle contrast curve lend a slightly melancholic, cinematic mood that works especially well in challenging natural light and at high ISOs.

label: Classic Chrome#0
description:
# Classic Chrome Preset Group

This collection draws inspiration from iconic film emulsions — from the legendary Kodachrome to the warm, gentle Portra — delivering a nostalgic, slightly faded palette with a characteristic golden shift and deep shadows. These presets are ideal for portraits and warm-light scenes: they flatter skin tones, enrich colors, and bring vintage charm to your images without pushing contrast too hard. With their smooth tonal gradation and natural grain, they shine when shooting in sunlight, during golden hour, or in the studio, wherever a lyrical, slightly retro atmosphere is what you're after.

label: Classic Chrome#1
description:
# Classic Chrome Film Presets

This preset collection recreates the magic of mid-20th-century film photography — soft contrast, warm shadows, and a gently muted palette. They're a great match for portrait and lifestyle shooting, thanks to flattering skin rendering, a nostalgic mood, and natural, non-oversaturated color. They work particularly well in everyday situations, from studio sessions to travel, whenever you want to preserve the authenticity of the moment and leave digital sharpness behind.

label: Classic Chrome#2
description:
# Classic Chrome — A Palette of Nostalgia and Film Charm

This recipe collection brings back the magic of classic color film — from the iconic Kodachrome and Kodacolor to the experimental look of cross-processing. Warm, slightly faded tones with soft contrast make these perfect for portraits, street scenes, and documentary work where you want a vintage feel without aggressive grain. Slightly reduced Clarity and lifted shadows hold detail in the highlights, delivering that genuine analog-era film feeling — romantic, a little overcast, and full of soul.

label: Classic Chrome#3
description:
# Classic Chrome — Elite Chrome Color Fade

This recipe recreates the distinctive aesthetic of classic color film — soft, slightly faded color with muted saturation. Lifted shadows combined with minimal contrast produce a gentle, nostalgic look with delicate grain, ideally suited to portrait work and scenes shot in bright daylight. A warm white balance with a yellow-orange bias gives the images a sunny, subtly vintage mood, as if the photograph had been sitting in sunlight for a decade.

label: Classic Negative#0
description:
# Classic Negative

This collection embodies the classic color negative aesthetic — warm, slightly diffused shadows and soft contrast — making it ideal for portraits and everyday shooting in natural light. The recipes nod to legendary stocks like Kodak Royal Gold and Fujifilm Superia, lending images a vintage charm with characteristic magenta and reddish tones. These presets are a reliable choice for anyone who values the nostalgia and organic quality of analog photography, without the need for complex post-processing.

label: Classic Negative#1
description:
# Classic Negative — A Set for Warm, Contrasty Classics

This preset collection recreates the character of Fujicolor film rendering — its signature warm tone and rich colors — making it an ideal choice for portraits, street photography, and documentary work. Reduced sharpness and contrast paired with expanded dynamic range deliver a soft, enveloping render with good shadow and highlight detail. The settings work beautifully in mixed light, naturally warming cool tones and adding depth and dimension to your subject.

label: Classic Negative#2
description:
# Classic Negative #2

This recipe collection recreates the warm, rich palette of classic color films — from the golden tones of Fujicolor 100 to the punchy Superia Xtra 400. Slightly reduced Clarity and gentle contrast give the images a touch of nostalgia and cinematic quality, evoking the atmosphere of summer days and street photography. They're ideal for portraits, landscapes, and documentary work in bright daylight, where natural color and artistic warmth are what matter most.

label: Classic Negative#3
description:
# Classic Negative: Subtle Nostalgia with a Contemporary Vision

This trio of presets takes a refined approach to the film aesthetic — soft shadows, restrained contrast, and a creamy palette combine to create a lyrical, gently vintage mood without tipping into excess pastels. They're particularly well suited to portraits, landscapes in difficult light, and everyday scenes where atmosphere is everything: they bring out shadow detail gracefully, adding a sense of airiness to the frame and a natural coolness to the highlights. The Bleach Bypass recipe offers a more contrasty alternative for those after a sharp, graphic quality, while Vintage Analog and Creamy Color are perfect for a soft, enveloping look — even on an overcast day.

label: Eterna Bleach Bypass#0
description:
# Eterna Bleach Bypass

This preset collection recreates the distinctive visual character of the bleach bypass process — muted, faded colors with a cool silver cast and minimal contrast. They're ideal for atmospheric, nostalgic shooting: moody portraits, urban scenes, and cinematic setups where you want dramatic highlight rolloff and the soft, grainy quality of aged motion picture film. These presets are especially effective in mixed or cold light conditions, amplifying the retro aesthetic and giving your images a slightly blurred, dreamlike quality.

label: Eterna Bleach Bypass#1
description:
# Eterna Bleach Bypass

This group of recipes recreates the distinctive look of the bleach bypass process while retaining the metallic sheen of the original film — cold, contrasty, and veiled in a subtle silver haze. The settings produce lifted highlights with deep shadows and accentuated Clarity, making them ideal for portrait and fine art photography where expressiveness and a degree of nostalgic drama are called for. These recipes are particularly striking under studio light or in contrasty daylight conditions, where you need to emphasize texture and three-dimensionality.

label: Eterna#0
description:
# Eterna — Cinematic Classics

This group of recipes recreates the warm, nostalgic look of motion picture film — soft contrast and golden shadows that are perfect for portraits and reportage with a historical undertone. Lifted highlights and shadows give the images a cinematic depth and dimensionality, while the smooth, flowing tonal transitions work especially well during golden hour or under soft studio light. These are the presets photographers reach for when they want a calm, contemplative feel — perfect for weddings, portrait series, and atmospheric documentary work where the authenticity of past decades matters.

label: Eterna#1
description:
# Eterna

This group of recipes recreates the aesthetic of classic motion picture film — warm, slightly languid color and soft contrast — making it ideal for portrait and reportage shooting in any lighting condition. Muted colors and visible grain create a nostalgic mood reminiscent of archival footage and exposed film stock; these presets are particularly effective indoors and in flat daylight. With a shift toward the shadows and preserved highlight detail, these filters handle high-contrast scenes well and bring out the character of portraits with a piercing, almost cinematic expressiveness.

label: Eterna#2
description:
# Eterna #2: Cine Teal & CineStill 800T

This pair of recipes recreates the look of warm motion picture film with a characteristic teal shift in the shadows — a perfect choice for cinematic shooting with an atmospheric, subtly nostalgic mood. Reduced Clarity and gentle light-to-shadow transitions create a dreamy, slightly overexposed quality that works especially well for evening scenes, portraits under artificial light, and urban photography. With expanded Dynamic Range and a pleasing film grain, these presets retain highlight detail and give your images an authentic cinematic look.

label: PRO Neg#0
description:
# PRO Neg #0 — Professional Negative Film

This group of recipes simulates classic professional color negative film — natural, gently rendered color with a delicate approach to the shadows — making it ideal for portrait and reportage work across a range of lighting conditions. These presets give images a warm, slightly soft character with pleasing grain, particularly well suited to city scenes, street photography, and night shooting. The settings prioritize highlight retention with a gentle approach to shadow development, making them a versatile tool for photographers working in changing conditions.

label: PRO Neg#1
description:
# PRO Neg #1 — Preset Group Description

This line of presets captures the sensuality of the film aesthetic — soft contrast and warm color shifts that are ideal for portraits and landscapes in natural light. Smooth shadow and highlight handling, subtle grain, and a gentle cooling of the blue channel evoke the atmosphere of a 1970s vintage film stock — nostalgic, but not overdone. These recipes particularly shine when shooting in overcast conditions or during soft-light hours, where they fully reveal the depth of the palette and bring out the textural quality of the scene.

label: PRO Neg#2
description:
# PRO Neg — Nostalgic Print

This classic negative film simulation captures the aesthetic of archival printing — soft contrast and muted color. It suits portrait and lifestyle shooting where naturalness and a nostalgic character are what you're after: reduced saturation and a warm white balance shift create the atmosphere of a vintage photograph. The preset works especially well on GFX cameras and is ideal for capturing meaningful moments where emotional authenticity matters more than technical perfection.

label: PRO Neg#3
description:
# PRO Neg #3

These presets recreate a distinctive cinematic style with lifted highlights and deep shadows characteristic of the bleach bypass technique — perfect for building a contrasty, slightly gritty film look with cool color rendering. Reach for them when shooting portraits, fashion, and urban scenes where you need a dramatic atmosphere and strong graphic quality without excess saturation. They perform well in mixed light and in a digital workflow, giving images the feel of genuine film material with characteristic grain.

label: PRO Neg#4
description:
# PRO Neg — Pure Negative

This simulation recreates the classic negative film aesthetic — a clean, low-contrast palette with natural tonal rendition. It suits portrait work in any lighting condition thanks to its gentle shadow handling and smooth tonal range that preserves detail in both highlights and shadows. Particularly well suited to documentary and lifestyle photography where you need an honest, non-oversaturated interpretation of the scene with just a barely perceptible warm shift.

label: Velvia
description:
# Velvia — A Palette of Rich Contrast

This group of presets, built on the legendary Velvia emulsion, is made for photographers who want deep color saturation and dramatic contrast. With a boosted blue channel, pronounced grain, and high Clarity, these recipes are ideal for landscape and adventure photography — especially on sunny days when nature's colors are already vivid and just need that extra punch. Golden hour sunsets, mountain landscapes, and bold urban scenes will come alive in full saturation, taking on a cinematic and slightly retro-exotic character.

label: Monochrome
description:
# Monochrome — Group of Black-and-White Film Simulations

This group of recipes recreates the classic aesthetic of black-and-white film photography — pronounced contrast and characteristic grain — making it well suited to portraits, architecture, and street photography. Average settings with lifted shadows (+2.4) and brightened highlights (+1.3) preserve shadow detail while keeping the highlights airy, and added Clarity and Sharpness give the images a three-dimensional, graphic quality. A calibrated white balance with a bias toward blue (-4.6) and red (+1.2) delivers a natural, neutral tone that allows the texture of the subject to come through at its fullest.

label: Provia
description:
# Provia — Group of Classic Positive and Negative Emulsions

This selection recreates the character of legendary film emulsions — from color negatives to positive slide films — with their characteristic tonal softness and warm, subtly muted palette. These recipes are ideal for portrait and documentary photography: they handle highlights gently, preserve shadow detail, and bring a nostalgic, meditative mood to images with natural grain. Choose this simulation for soft light, street photography on overcast days, or studio sessions where smooth skin rendering is a priority and aggressive contrast is the last thing you need.

label: Astia
description:
# Astia: Softness and Delicacy

A group of presets for fans of a subdued, romantic aesthetic, with the gentle contrast and slightly open shadows characteristic of Astia. Lifted highlights and subtle warm-leaning color correction make these ideal for portraits, love stories, and fashion photography in natural light. Despite modest grain and a slight softening of Clarity, the presets retain a sense of airiness and smooth skin tones, delivering that genuine film look with a nostalgic quality that is so valued in wedding and lifestyle photography.
